summary: Read integers stored in an array that contains at least one entry. Exactly one value occurs a single time, and every remaining value occurs two times. Find that unique value and write it. The steps you take must stay proportional to how many entries were read, and extra memory must be only a few variables whose count does not depend on that length. Entries may be negative or zero, and the two copies of a value need not be adjacent.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
